title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of [0.0067, 0.0469, 0.0]. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. For the first loop, draw an arc starting at [0.0, 0.0067], passing through [0.002, 0.002], and ending at [0.0067, 0.0]. Continue with a line from [0.0067, 0.0] to [0.0335, 0.0], followed by another arc starting at [0.0335, 0.0], passing through [0.0382, 0.002], and ending at [0.0402, 0.0067]. Draw a line from [0.0402, 0.0067] to [0.0402, 0.0335], then an arc starting at [0.0402, 0.0335], passing through [0.0382, 0.0382], and ending at [0.0335, 0.0402]. Follow with a line from [0.0335, 0.0402] to [0.0067, 0.0402], and an arc starting at [0.0067, 0.0402], passing through [0.002, 0.0382], and ending at [0.0, 0.0335]. Finally, draw a line from [0.0, 0.0335] to [0.0, 0.0067]. For the second loop, start with an arc from [0.0022, 0.0076], passing through [0.0038, 0.0038], and ending at [0.0076, 0.0022]. Draw a line from [0.0076, 0.0022] to [0.0326, 0.0022], followed by an arc from [0.0326, 0.0022], passing through [0.0364, 0.0038], and ending at [0.0379, 0.0076]. Continue with a line from [0.0379, 0.0076] to [0.0379, 0.0326], then an arc from [0.0379, 0.0326], passing through [0.0364, 0.0364], and ending at [0.0326, 0.0379]. Draw a line from [0.0326, 0.0379] to [0.0076, 0.0379], and an arc from [0.0076, 0.0379], passing through [0.0038, 0.0364], and ending at [0.0022, 0.0326]. Finish with a line from [0.0022, 0.0326] to [0.0022, 0.0076]. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0402. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0067, 0.0469, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object with a rectangular section at the top are length 0.04017857142857143, width 0.04017857142857143, and height 0.7500000000000001.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Define the outer loop
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0067).threePointArc((0.002, 0.002), (0.0067, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0335, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0382, 0.002), (0.0402, 0.0067))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0402, 0.0335).threePointArc((0.0382, 0.0382), (0.0335, 0.0402))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0067, 0.0402).threePointArc((0.002, 0.0382), (0.0, 0.0335))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Define the inner loop
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0022, 0.0076).threePointArc((0.0038, 0.0038), (0.0076, 0.0022))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0326, 0.0022).threePointArc((0.0364, 0.0038), (0.0379, 0.0076))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0379, 0.0326).threePointArc((0.0364, 0.0364), (0.0326, 0.0379))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0076, 0.0379).threePointArc((0.0038, 0.0364), (0.0022, 0.0326))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Translate the model
r = r.translate((0.0067, 0.0469, 0.0))

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define dimensions
outer_size = 0.0402
wall = 0.005
height = 0.7500
inner_size = outer_size - 2 * wall

# Create outer square profile and cut the inner square to form a tube
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(outer_size, outer_size)
    .rect(inner_size, inner_size)
    .extrude(height)
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the dimensions
outer_width = 0.0402
outer_height = 0.7500
wall_thickness = 0.0043

# Calculate the inner dimensions
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness

# Create the outer box
outer_box = cq.Workplane("XY").box(outer_width, outer_width, outer_height)

# Create the inner box to subtract
inner_box = cq.Workplane("XY").box(inner_width, inner_width, outer_height)

# Subtract the inner box from the outer box to create the hollow pipe
r = outer_box.cut(inner_box)
